content:
Hi everyone! I’m Christian Kithima Omba, a mathematician from Kinshasa. I am working on the formalization of a spectral reduction framework to analyze complexity classes.

I have set up my Lean 4 repository here: https://github.com/christiankithimaomba-cyber/spectral-reduction-framework

The project includes a core library for spectral theory (in the Noyau folder) and initial work on P vs NP (in the PNP folder). Any feedback is welcome! Happy to be here!
